title: Tracker Needle Frame
description: The per-frame needle position the Jetson tracker broadcasts on its WebSocket after `hello`, wire protocol v2 (needle-simulator packages/needle-jetson/.../tracker/engine.py, _triangulate_and_broadcast(), with the two length fields from packages/needle-pipeline/.../pipeline/measure.py needle_length_fields()). Consumers: apps/desktop/src/types.ts (NeedleFrameWire) and lib/tracking/wire.ts, packages/needle-eval/.../schema.py (TrackEvent). Unlike `hello` and `status`, this frame has NO `type` field: the desktop client (ws_client.rs) treats every post-hello frame whose `type` is not `status` as a needle frame, so there is no discriminator to put in an envelope. All coordinates are tracker (trk) mm on the three.js axes (X right, Y up, Z depth). Only v2 names are described here; the v1 spellings (confA/confB, surfaceX/Y/Z, lenSurfaceTip, lenEntryTip) are a consumer-side compatibility concern and are deliberately not part of this contract.
$comment: additionalProperties is true and MUST stay true: the tracker's stated rule is that additive optional fields do NOT bump protocol_version (see tracker/hello.json). `required` lists exactly what the producer sends on every frame; a frame that omits one of them is not a v2 frame (a v1 rig lacks conf_lo, skin_entry_*, surface_to_tip_mm and entry_to_tip_mm, and is rejected here on purpose).

entryX.description: Surface-snapped entry point X, tracker mm.

entryY.description: Surface-snapped entry point Y, tracker mm.

entryZ.description: Surface-snapped entry point Z, tracker mm.

timestamp.description: Wall-clock time (Unix seconds, float) at which the engine built this frame.

source.description: `detected` = this frame had a fresh detection; `predicted` = detection was lost and the Kalman prediction is being broadcast. The producer never emits `lost`: that value exists only in the desktop's type and its e2e mock.

conf_lo.description: Detection confidence of the LO camera face (AprilTag ids 0-3). null when this frame had no detection on both faces (including every `predicted` frame).

conf_hi.description: Detection confidence of the HI camera face (AprilTag ids 4-7). null under the same conditions as conf_lo.

lastDetectionTimestamp.description: Wall-clock time (Unix seconds) of the last frame with a fresh detection. null if the engine has none since its last reset.

skin_entry_x.description: Skin-surface entry point X, tracker mm: where the needle line crosses the phantom's visible top face. null when the line does not cross it.

skin_entry_y.description: Skin-surface entry point Y, tracker mm. null together with skin_entry_x.

skin_entry_z.description: Skin-surface entry point Z, tracker mm. null together with skin_entry_x.

surface_to_tip_mm.description: Insertion length: skin-surface point to tip, mm. null when skin_entry_* is null.

entry_to_tip_mm.description: Length from the surface-snapped entry point to the tip, mm. Never null.
